name: hat_crown
where: Hat body y 0.93 to 1.005, roughly x 0.40-0.56 wide, flat-topped tapered cylinder, oval plan (longer front to back).
shape: Flat-topped fedora/pork-pie-like crown with slightly tapering sides and a rounded top rim.
in_reference: differs: reference crown is a pinched fedora with a dent; sculpt is flatter and more cylindrical
notes: Sits on brim; hat band wraps its base. Top face is a shallow dished surface.

name: hat_crown_eye_dents
where: Front face of crown, y 0.965-0.99, left and right of centre line (x ~0.44 and ~0.52); the right one (character right) wraps toward the side.
shape: Two angled, almond-shaped hollow dents (angry skull-eye shapes) pressed into the crown front, joined by a nose-like ridge above the badge.
in_reference: differs: reference has a pinched crown crease, no eye dents
notes: Sculpted depressions, could be baked normal detail rather than modelled; they are deep enough to read in silhouette in fr/right.

name: hat_brim
where: y 0.915-0.945, spans x ~0.34-0.62 in front view, z deeper in front; wide oval, drooping at edges.
shape: Wide downward-curving brim with a rolled/thickened edge, slightly wider at front and back, thick lip around the border.
notes: Brim underside is dark/near-black. Edge has a raised rolled rim (could be separate binding strip, but looks fused). Orange wear paint only.

name: hat_brim_edge_rim
where: Continuous around brim perimeter.
shape: Thickened rolled lip or binding that runs the full brim edge.
notes: May just be part of the brim thickness; list for modeller decision.

name: hat_band
where: Ring around base of crown, y 0.935-0.96; front section wider and gold, rear section darker.
shape: Wide band wrapping the crown; front half is a broad gold-coloured metal-looking plate strip, sides and back narrow darker leather strap.
notes: Front gold section reads as metal plate over a leather strap; rear is leather/dark. Could be one band with a gold front plate layered on top.

name: hat_band_front_plate
where: Front of band, x ~0.38-0.58 in front view, y 0.935-0.955.
shape: Gold curved plate that is thicker in the middle and tapers at the ends, wrapping about 120 degrees around the front.
in_reference: differs: reference has plain dark band with a small gold emblem
notes: Sits over the leather band. Boundary with rear dark strap is at the side near the buckle loops.

name: hat_band_emblem
where: Centre front of hat band, x ~0.47, y 0.935-0.965.
shape: Gold diamond/kite emblem of crossed bars with a small point on top (spiky compass-like cross in a rhombus), raised from plate.
notes: Reference shows a smaller star-like diamond badge at the same position. Separate small piece on top of the plate.

name: hat_band_studs
where: Round domed studs along the band: 1 at front right of the emblem (x~0.52), 3 on the back (x~0.44,0.47,0.50 view back), about 2 each side on the flanks; 1 small at front left near the emblem.
shape: Small round domed gold studs, evenly spaced around the band.
in_reference: differs: reference shows few or no visible studs
notes: Count approximate (back view shows 3 studs clearly, front shows 1 right of emblem, sides show 2-3 each). Mixed with stirrup loops on sides.

name: hat_band_loops
where: Along the flanks of the band, 2 on each side (left side y~0.95 at z 0.14-0.2; right side similar), standing proud as vertical slots.
shape: Small vertical rounded-rectangle loops/staples that pass over the band, alternating with studs.
notes: Pill-shaped slotted staples. Gold colour in texture. May be considered belt-loop keepers for the band.

name: hat_band_back_loops
where: Back, at either end of the 3-stud row (x~0.39 and ~0.50 in back view), y ~0.955.
shape: Small vertical hook-shaped staples at the back corners of the band.
notes: May be the same objects as the flank loops; or the buckle/ends of the band joining at the back.

name: hat_band_side_buckle
where: Character-left side of band near the front, z ~0.27, y 0.935-0.965, left panel.
shape: Small spiky vertical hook/buckle with prongs protruding past the band outline.
in_reference: differs: reference shows a gold buckle/clasp on the band side
notes: There is also something similar on the right side (right panel, z~0.22, shorter). The two sides differ; may be band overlap ends.

name: hat_crown_stud_right
where: Right side of crown above the band, y ~0.98, near z 0.16 in right/br view.
shape: Single tiny domed rivet on the crown surface.
notes: Only on the right side; may be sculpt artefact.

name: hat_brim_stud
where: Front left of the brim top, near the edge, x ~0.37 y ~0.92 (front view); another small bump on the front of brim under the dent in top view (z front edge).
shape: Tiny round bump on the brim surface.
notes: Small bump, 2 total (one top-view front edge, one top-view lower left).

name: hat_inner_sweatband
where: Inside the hat, seen from below at the opening of the crown, y ~0.93.
shape: Oval inner lining ring and crown underside visible inside the hat.
notes: The hat is open underneath, head sits inside; head cap hidden within.

name: mask_visor
where: Face front, from under brim (y ~0.915) down to a point at y ~0.855, x ~0.40-0.52, z front.
shape: Orange glowing face plate: wide at the top, tapering to a downward point (beak/shield shape) with a raised rim and a vertical wedge in the middle, side wings curving back toward the ears.
notes: Includes raised border; two vertical glowing slits are in the face.

name: mask_slits
where: Two long vertical grooves on the mask face, x ~0.44 and ~0.49, y 0.865-0.915, green-yellow glow.
shape: Narrow vertical engraved slits that glow yellow-green, with raised ribs between.
notes: Geometry recessed; reference shows 2-3 glowing vertical bars. Needs to be real recessed/emissive geometry.

name: mask_rim
where: Outline of mask, down the side edges and to the point, plus central raised V ridge.
shape: Raised border lip around the mask edge with a vertical centre ridge.
notes: May be part of mask rather than separate.

name: head_skull
where: y 0.86-0.93, behind the mask, under the hat; x ~0.40-0.55, z 0.10-0.26.
shape: Dark bare head/skull, with face covered by mask; back of head and sides in near-black.
notes: Mostly hidden by hat, mask and collar. Skin is dark.

name: ear
where: Sides of head at y ~0.90-0.925, z ~0.15-0.19, just behind the mask edge, below brim; left ear visible in left and bl panels, right ear in right and br.
shape: Detailed human ear with helix and concha.
notes: Both present. Partially occluded by collar and brim.

name: hair_nape
where: Back of the head under the brim, y ~0.91, in back view.
shape: Short hair at nape, vague dark mass between hat and collar.
in_reference: differs: side reference shows short hair tufts under the hat
notes: The sculpt shows only smooth head; no distinct hair.

name: neck_wrap
where: Front of neck below mask, y 0.82-0.87, x ~0.40-0.50, visible in the V of the coat opening.
shape: Dark scarf or high-neck inner layer with folds, forming V under the mask point, with ribbed panel lines.
notes: Near-black, layered under coat collar. Includes a cross-over panel edge with gold line trim at the right in fr view.

name: neck_wrap_trim
where: Down the front of the neck wrap, two thin lines forming a V from collar tips toward chest, y 0.80-0.88.
shape: Thin gold-edged piping lines running down the inner front edges.
notes: Could be edge piping of coat lapels instead.

name: collar_stand_back
where: Wraps round the back and sides of the neck from y ~0.82 up to 0.90 (back) and up to y ~0.93 on the sides; x 0.34-0.58.
shape: Tall stand-up collar with wavy wrinkles, flaring outwards at the top, thick dark edge rim.
notes: Back portion has horizontal wave folds. Rear collar top edge lowers at the nape and the sides are the tallest.

name: collar_left_lapel_tip
where: Character-left front, y 0.86-0.91, x ~0.56-0.60 in front view; side tall tip visible in left panel at z 0.10-0.14.
shape: Pointed folded-over front collar flap, with gold edge trim.
notes: Overlaps the underlying shoulder; collar front leaf wraps to the front of the coat lapel.

name: collar_right_lapel_tip
where: Character-right front, y 0.86-0.91, x ~0.33-0.37 in front view; seen in right panel at z 0.10-0.20.
shape: Pointed front collar flap mirroring the left, slightly folded.
notes: Slightly different drape from the left.

name: collar_edge_trim
where: Top edge and front edges of the collar, around the entire stand-up collar.
shape: Thin gold/dark rolled piping along the collar perimeter and lapel edges.
notes: Appears as a raised rolled edge in clay; colour is dark on the back, gold on the front lapels.

name: collar_lapel_stud
where: On the front lapel points, around x ~0.35 and ~0.58, y ~0.87 (partly cropped).
shape: Round domed gold studs on the collar lapel.
notes: Reference shows studs on the lapels; sculpt shows a few small bumps near the left tip only (left tip at x~0.58).
